affectedNodeIds.description: IDs of existing nodes that need modification, including nodes whose connections must change. Empty if no changes are required.

addNodes.description: True if any new nodes need to be created, false otherwise.

removeNodeIds.description: IDs of nodes that should be removed entirely or replaced/split into new nodes. Must be disjoint from affectedNodeIds.

payloadChangeRequired.description: True only if the user explicitly requests adding, removing, renaming, or changing the type of a starting payload variable.

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why nodes are affected, OR a user-friendly conversational message if no generation is required.
